text: The purpose of this report is to inform Toronto City Council, pursuant to Chapter 195 of the Toronto Municipal Code (Purchasing By-Law, Section 195-7.4) of a non-competitive purchase order with BDA Inc. for the replacement of the existing roof at 291 Sherbourne Street (the “Property”) in the amount of $2,075,000 net of all taxes and charges ($2,111,520 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries). The Property, which is known as Robertson House, is a shelter facility owned by the City of Toronto and operated by Shelter, Support and Housing Administration. The Property is a short-term emergency shelter with a capacity of 74 occupants. The Property is comprised of several buildings. The main building’s roof requires immediate replacement due to an unforeseen site condition of water leaks that have caused damage to the ceilings, walls, and floors of the interior space.
